run_DETR_training: run the detection transformer training loop on COCO dataset with configurable backbone and optimizer
run_DETR_evaluation: run evaluation of a trained detection transformer model on the test dataset with bbox and mask metrics
run_DETR_distributed_training: run distributed multi-GPU training of the detection transformer with configurable world size and batch size
run_DETR_resume_training: resume detection transformer training from a saved checkpoint file with optimizer and scheduler state
run_DETR_custom_config: run the detection transformer with custom hyperparameters including learning rate, dropout, and number of encoder decoder layers
